purpose: Teach: のぞみ/りゅう/秀樹/和彦/優作/三男/英男/誠一

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが新幹線のぞみの開業を喜ばれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad was so happy when the Nozomi bullet train opened…
lines.style: Soft, gentle opening. Memory surfacing like an old photograph. Quiet pace, warm register. Trailing off slightly—not asking for confirmation, just… remembering aloud.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、お兄様のりゅうさんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear—and your grandfather, when he was young, he used to play shogi with your brother Ryu, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial tone. Gently teasing—she knows the answer. Slight lift on the question mark, like she's inviting him to lean in and remember alongside her. Conversational, unrushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが西城秀樹の曲を口ずさまれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad used to hum Hideki Saijo's songs…
lines.style: Same gentle opening. The memory held even more softly this time. Quieter breath. Slower pace still. The voice of someone sitting with what was, not grasping for it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご友人の和彦さんと釣りに行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, when he was young, he went fishing with your friend Kazuhiko, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Same warm teasing. Slightly more animated this time—she's remembering something he did, not just something he received. Gentle lift at the end, drawing him in gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが松田優作のデビュー作を観られた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad saw Yusaku Matsuda's film debut…
lines.style: Opening note even softer. The third memory—almost reverent now. Very slow pace. Breath held between phrases. Like he's handing over something precious, not just recalling it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、「ご自身は三男坊」と謙遜されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, when he was young, he used to say he was the third son and didn't make a fuss about it, did he, dear?
lines.style: Warm and knowing. A gentle correction—she's steering back to something true about him, not just what he received. Slight pride in her voice. Affectionate, steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご友人の英男さんと俳句を詠まれた
lines.en: Gran, when he was young, Dad composed haiku with your friend Hideo…
lines.style: Almost a whisper now. The memory has become sacred in the telling. Slowest pace yet. Long silence between words. The voice of someone holding something finished, beautiful, and gone.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご友人の誠一さんとお酒を酌み交わされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather, when he was young, he used to share sake with your friend Seiichi, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmest yet. Not teasing now—celebrating. She's brought him full circle back to his own story. Soft close, like a hand on his arm. Breath warm and close.
